texts:
Lane Johnson retired Tuesday, four games into his 14th year.

Philadelphia plays JAX in London without its right tackle, top back, top receiver or top tight end.

Will Shipley is the last healthy back. Claim him, 10 to 15 percent.

Let's dive in.
#FlyEaglesFly #DUUUVAL

Jalen Hurts loses his right tackle on top of the injuries at back, receiver and tight end.

QB3 rest of season for me. Hold him; two bad weeks behind the rebuilt line would change that, one game in London will not.
#FlyEaglesFly #DUUUVAL

Saquon Barkley is week to week with the hamstring and almost certainly misses Sunday's 9:30 AM ET game in London. It is not considered long term.

RB8 rest of season for me; hold him. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
#FlyEaglesFly

Will Shipley played 28 of 61 snaps vs LAR, and Tank Bigsby is on IR.

Shipley is the only other back on the active roster, so he leads the backfield in London. Claim him, 10 to 15 percent of FAAB.
#FlyEaglesFly

Seattle passed on Joe Mixon after his physical Tuesday and will sign Robert Henry Jr. instead. Drop Mixon.

Emanuel Wilson ran 21 times with 2 TDs vs LAC and has the whole job vs SF. Claim him, 10 to 15 percent of FAAB.
#Seahawks #FTTB

Zach Charbonnet is ruled out vs SF, so Week 6 is the earliest he plays. RB49 rest of season for me. Stash him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB.

Robert Henry Jr. is a depth signing. Leave him on the wire.
#Seahawks #FTTB

Lamar Jackson has a sprained left ankle and only an outside chance to play @ATL Sunday night, and it could cost him more than one game.

QB2 rest of season for me; hold him. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#RavensFlock #DirtyBirds

Tyler Huntley starts @ATL if Jackson sits. He went 8 of 9 in relief, and Baltimore scored on none of his five drives.

Superflex only: stash him, 6 to 10 percent of FAAB.
#RavensFlock #DirtyBirds

Tyquan Thornton needs ankle surgery and misses 12 to 16 weeks. Drop him.

Xavier Worthy takes the vertical routes. WR55 rest of season for me; hold him.

Rashee Rice's hamstring is called relatively minor over the bye. WR17 rest of season; hold.
#ChiefsKingdom

Washington plans to have Jayden Daniels back as the starter vs NYG after a full week of practice on the elbow. QB18 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Athan Kaliakmanis went 15 of 33 in London. Drop him in superflex.
#RaiseHail #NYGiants

Puka Nacua caught 9 for 125 @PHI in his first game back, with a pre-hernia that could need surgery later.

WR6 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR2.
#RamsHouse #FlyEaglesFly

Tyler Higbee caught 5 for 67 @PHI and led the Rams tight ends in snaps for a second straight game.

TE44 rest of season for me. In TE-premium and deep leagues, add him, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
#RamsHouse #FlyEaglesFly

Ashton Jeanty caught 6 of 8 for 68 vs KC, but the ankle cut into his snaps.

RB9 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.

Mike Washington Jr. picks up the snaps if Jeanty sits. RB43 rest of season; hold him.
#RaiderNation #ChiefsKingdom

Chris Olave limped off after a late hit Monday and avoided a major injury. WR7 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Tyler Shough hurt his left hand. QB12 rest of season. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#Saints #DirtyBirds

Pat Bryant has a suspected high-ankle sprain and misses a few weeks. WR63 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add.

RJ Harvey caught 10 passes @SF. RB41 rest of season. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.
#BroncosCountry #FTTB

Arizona lost left tackle Paris Johnson Jr. for the season, with DET next.

Jeremiyah Love's ankle flared again. RB14 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Tyler Allgeier ran 8 for 42 and a TD. Claim him, 3 to 6 percent.
#BirdGang #OnePride

Rashawn Slater (high ankle) and Joe Alt (neck) both got hurt @SEA.

Justin Herbert is QB13 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's report on both tackles.

Keaton Mitchell out-touched Omarion Hampton 15 to 9. Claim Mitchell, 4 to 8 percent.
#BoltUp #Seahawks

Ja'Marr Chase is in the concussion protocol and Tee Higgins has the adductor strain. Monitor both; Wednesday's practice report.

Dohnte Meyers caught 7 for 82 once Chase left. Claim him, 8 to 15 percent of FAAB.
#WhoDey

Keon Coleman played 46 of 59 snaps and caught 6 of 7 for 116 and a TD after DJ Moore left. WR95 rest of season for me. Claim him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB.

DJ Moore is day to day with the shoulder. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#BillsMafia

Every call from today, with the source behind it, is on the Pass page. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the Menu tomorrow, and send this to the Eagles fan in your league.
